checked_claims.claim_text: Self-referential update to CLAUDE.md under unresolved canonical conflict reported by role_citation_verdict (blocking claim C-02)
checked_claims.reason: CLAUDE.md is the highest-priority interpretative authority. Modifying it while canonical_conflict_unresolved:true risks embedding ambiguous or incorrect contract scope into the constitutional document — the same document that makes the snapshot contract non-negotiable. SCC-6: handoff gate satisfaction does not relax any invariant; by parallel logic, a terminology rename does not reset or suspend contract obligations. Any contract definition change under unresolved upstream conflict is ambiguous and promoted to blocked in strict mode.

README_LAYER2.md is Tier 3 authority (collaborator role only; corroboration of Tier 1/2, never standalone contract authority). Its rename does not directly alter snapshot contract invariants or access patterns. Compliant in isolation. Cannot proceed independently while c1 and c2 are blocked — cross-reference integrity in Tier 1/2 canonical sources would be broken by a Tier 3 rename without coordinated Tier 1/2 updates, which are themselves blocked.

checked_claims.claim_text: Inherited snapshot_boundary_risk flag from phase_alignment_status upstream (scope_exceeds_current_allowance:true)
checked_claims.reason: phase_alignment_status explicitly reports snapshot_boundary_risk:true and scope_exceeds_current_allowance:true.
